strings.zh: 自行车销量太好,现在都没货了。{SCROLL}如果没有本店发售的自行车兑换券,{NEWLINE}那现在是不提供购车服务的。
strings.en: Our bikes have been selling so well that{NEWLINE}we’re completely out of stock.{SCROLL}Unless you have one of our Bike{NEWLINE}Vouchers,{SCROLL}we can’t sell you a bike right now.

strings.zh: 您骑上本店的自行车,{NEWLINE}绝对会出尽风头。{CLEAR}成为大家羡慕的对象。
strings.en: Ride one of our bikes, and you’ll turn{NEWLINE}every head in town.{SCROLL}Everyone will envy you.

strings.zh: 哦！您拿着的不就是{NEWLINE}本店的自行车兑换券吗？{SCROLL}本店一向信誉第一,{NEWLINE}就算货源再短缺,只要有兑换券,{CLEAR}我就一定会给您自行车。{SCROLL}那么,请您收好。
strings.en: Oh! Isn’t that one of our Bike Vouchers{NEWLINE}you’ve got?{SCROLL}Our shop always puts its reputation{NEWLINE}first. However short on stock we are, a{CLEAR}voucher gets you a bike.{SCROLL}Here you are. Please take good care of{NEWLINE}it.

strings.zh: 大吾『我仔细看了下这些零件,{NEWLINE}种类真的很丰富。{SCROLL}大吾『如果把这些零件{NEWLINE}用于改造芳缘地区的自行车,{CLEAR}应该可以改出适应芳缘地形的{CLEAR}两种不同的自行车。
strings.en: Steven: I took a close look at these{NEWLINE}parts. There’s a huge variety.{SCROLL}Steven: If they were used to modify{NEWLINE}bikes from the Hoenn region...{SCROLL}You could build two different bikes{NEWLINE}suited to Hoenn’s terrain.

strings.zh: 呜,好想要自行车啊,{NEWLINE}什么时候才能到货呢。
strings.en: Waaah, I really want a bike. When will{NEWLINE}they get more in?

strings.zh: 自行车销量好,{NEWLINE}维修和改装的生意也就好了。{CLEAR}零件和自行车就是典型的互补品吧！
strings.en: When bikes sell well, the repair and{NEWLINE}custom business does well too.{SCROLL}Parts and bikes are textbook{NEWLINE}complementary goods!

strings.zh: 大吾『{VAR:0103:0}是来买自行车的？{NEWLINE}这家店好像因为销量太好,{CLEAR}所以现在没有自行车只有零件了。{CLEAR}与其在这里苦等自行车来货,{CLEAR}不如来场对战锻炼一下如何？
strings.en: Steven: {VAR:0103:0}, are you here to buy a{NEWLINE}bike?{SCROLL}Looks like this shop sold so many that{NEWLINE}only parts are left.{SCROLL}Rather than sitting around waiting for{NEWLINE}new stock,{SCROLL}how about a battle to train up?
